design.issuance: POST /platform/venues/:venueId/manager-links; current ACTIVE SUPER_ADMIN only. SUPPORT_READONLY GET only, owner has no issuance/cancel path.
design.readiness: Current ACTIVE Venue + MANAGER_APP + at least one active MANAGER/ADMIN. Cannot bootstrap initial Staff.
design.code: 20 Crockford base32 characters;8 indexed public selector +12 secret characters (60-bit secret), Argon2id verifier;30-minute expiry;5 durable failed verifications.
design.redemption: POST /auth/manager-link {code,installationId}; no client Venue authority. Venue/issuer/features rechecked; Venue row serializes single-use consumption and audit.
design.retry: Same installation UUID + same code may retry within expiry after lost reply; different installation denied. UUID is retry identity, not authentication/attestation.
design.subsequentLogin: Returned public Venue metadata remembered per backend origin; PIN and existing unique-active-Staff match still required; link grants no session, no Staff creation, no PIN write.
design.compatibility: Existing remembered Venue selections and Staff sessions remain; legacy lookup retained for old clients, new first-time UI uses real one-use code.
design.reissueCancel: Supersedes unused codes; consumed links and installed Staff sessions are not revoked.
